body.purpose: Reading copy on newsprint and cover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sindoor stamp. The one action on a page.
components.css: .button-primary { background: #9c1c16; color: #fff; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 2px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A booklet plate. Newsprint, hairline, no lift.

narrative.overview: The site is a cheap offset-printed Char Dham yatra booklet, not a mountain-hero travel template. Cover is marigold; interior pages are newsprint. Trust is the product.
keyCharacteristics: Marigold cover, newsprint interior, sindoor stamp for the one action
Bound plates with hairline rules; no drop shadows
Mobile-first, one CSS file, no UI framework

rules.name: The Cover Rule
rules.body: Marigold is a field, not an accent chip.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Rasa for titles; Atkinson for reading and controls.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: Cards are booklet plates. Do not lift or nest them.

dos: Do start from the phone width and expand.
Do consume colour, type, and space from tokens.
donts: Don't ship a mountain-hero + serif + terracotta travel template.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't introduce a UI framework or a third font family.
